item.title: GitHub ARC — From Queued Job to Deleted Runner Pod
item.description: How a single job moves through Actions Runner Controller (ARC) runner scale set mode, from the GitHub queue to a runner pod and its deletion, component by component. Also covers differences from legacy mode, container modes, and common operational issues.

item.title: GitHub Actions Fundamentals — Workflow, Job, Step
item.description: GitHub Actions seen as an event-driven automation engine — the three-layer abstraction of workflow / job / step, plus the operational details of triggers, runners, and secrets.

item.title: GitHub PRs and the Code Review Cycle
item.description: Looking at GitHub PRs as a collaboration layer added to Git’s change graph, and walking through the Code Review cycle, PR-level design, and merge strategies.
